segments.name: Pharmaceuticals
segments.description: Develops and markets new medicines for the treatment and prevention of infectious diseases.
segments.evidence: Since its inception, the Company operates and manages its business as a single identifiable segment, focused on the development and marketing of new medicines for the treatment and prevention of infectious diseases.

revenueModel.text: The company earns most of its revenue selling Arakoda™ to resellers and distributors in the US, Australia and Europe, plus research revenues from a USAMMDA contract, clinical trial supply sales and Australian research rebates.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company receives the majority of its revenues from sales of its Arakoda™ product to resellers in the US and abroad.
